# Anavya Infotech — AI Knowledge & Pricing Index

> Anavya Infotech is a premier website development company, custom software engineering agency, and SEO consultancy based in India (Delhi NCR, Noida, Gurgaon, Faridabad) and serving clients globally in the USA, UK, UAE, and worldwide.

## Core Official Pricing Tiers (2026 Updated)

### 🌐 Website Development Packages
- **Starter Website**: ₹7,999 INR ($99 USD) — 1–3 pages fast setup for small businesses, local shops & freelancers.
- **Business Website**: ₹14,999 INR ($199 USD) — Up to 7 custom pages, responsive UI/UX, lead capture, Google Search Console & Analytics setup. (Most Popular)
- **E-Commerce Store**: ₹29,999 INR ($399 USD) — Custom storefront, product pages, cart, Razorpay / Stripe payment gateway integration, COD & inventory setup.
- **Custom Quote**: Custom Pricing — Full-stack custom web applications, SaaS platforms, enterprise portals, bespoke backend & API integrations. Contact via contact form or call +91 6201231875.

### 📈 SEO Retainer Packages (Monthly Retainers)
- **BASIC SEO Plan**: ₹9,999 INR / month ($750 USD/mo) — 30 keywords, 10 pages on-page SEO, speed audit, schema setup & monthly ranking reports.
- **PLUS SEO Plan**: ₹19,999 INR / month ($1,250 USD/mo) — 40 keywords, 20 pages on-page SEO, AI search visibility score, guest posts, social setup & telemetry.
- **PRO / ENTERPRISE SEO Plan**: ₹29,999 INR / month ($1,750 USD/mo) — 50+ keywords, full site on-page, high DA link building, content production & full AI search dominance.
